sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Pachypodium rosulatum is a caudiciform shrub of Madagascar, adapted to dry habitats. Height and form vary among its recognised subspecies, so a single size should not be generalised.

sections.title: Caudex, leaves and flowers
sections.text: The swollen base and spiny branches store water. The leaves form terminal rosettes. The tubular flowers are yellow; the plate shows a form with a particularly enlarged caudex.

sections.title: Comparison and edibility
sections.text: P. rosulatum differs from P. baronii by its yellow rather than red flowers. No safe food use was found.
